name: mcp-swiss
description: Swiss open data MCP server — 79 tools, 22 modules, zero API keys
long_description: mcp-swiss gives any AI assistant direct access to Swiss open data. 79 tools across 22 modules: train schedules (SBB), weather (MeteoSwiss), river levels (BAFU), geodata (swisstopo), company registry (ZEFIX), parliament (OpenParlData.ch), avalanche bulletins, holidays, postal services, electricity prices, population statistics, exchange rates (SNB), recycling schedules, news (SRF), voting results, dam registry, hiking trail alerts, real estate data, traffic counts, earthquake monitoring, and snow conditions (SLF). All APIs are free and require zero authentication.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search public transport stations/stops by name or coordinates

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: Train/bus connections between two locations

tools.name: get_departures
tools.description: Live departures from a station

tools.name: get_arrivals
tools.description: Live arrivals at a station

tools.name: get_nearby_stations
tools.description: Stations near coordinates

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current weather at a MeteoSwiss station. For past dates use get_weather_history

tools.name: list_weather_stations
tools.description: List MeteoSwiss weather station codes

tools.name: get_weather_history
tools.description: Historical weather readings for a MeteoSwiss station. Only the last 32 days are available

tools.name: get_water_level
tools.description: Current river/lake level and temperature at a BAFU hydro station

tools.name: list_hydro_stations
tools.description: List BAFU hydro station IDs (rivers, lakes)

tools.name: get_water_history
tools.description: Historical river/lake levels for a BAFU hydro station. Only the last 32 days are available

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Address or place name to WGS84 coordinates (swisstopo)

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: WGS84 coordinates to address (swisstopo)

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search place names, localities, mountains, geographic features

tools.name: get_solar_potential
tools.description: Rooftop solar potential at a location

tools.name: identify_location
tools.description: Geographic features and swisstopo data layers at a location

tools.name: get_municipality
tools.description: Municipality info by name

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search the ZEFIX commercial register by company name, optionally filtered by canton/legal form

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Full company details by ZEFIX ehraid (from search_companies)

tools.name: search_companies_by_locality
tools.description: Companies whose registered seat is in a commune/town. ZEFIX has no street-address search

tools.name: list_cantons
tools.description: List cantons with codes

tools.name: list_legal_forms
tools.description: List company legal forms (AG, GmbH, ...) with the ids used by search_companies

tools.name: get_public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for a year, national and cantonal

tools.name: get_school_holidays
tools.description: School holiday periods for a year, by canton

tools.name: is_holiday_today
tools.description: Whether today is a public holiday

tools.name: search_parliament_business
tools.description: Full-text search of federal parliament affairs (bills, motions, interpellations, postulates, questions, initiatives). For cantonal parliaments use search_cantonal_affairs

tools.name: get_parliament_members
tools.description: Federal parliament members (National Council, Council of States), filterable by canton/party

tools.name: get_parliament_votes
tools.description: Recorded votes on a parliamentary affair (Geschäft)

tools.name: get_session_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming and recent federal parliament sessions

tools.name: search_parliament_speeches
tools.description: Debate speeches on a parliamentary affair

tools.name: get_politician_interests
tools.description: Declared interests and mandates (boards, consulting roles) of a federal parliament member

tools.name: search_cantonal_affairs
tools.description: Search affairs in a cantonal parliament (Kantonsrat), all 26 cantons

tools.name: get_parliamentary_documents
tools.description: Official documents (reports, committee opinions, Federal Council statements) for a parliamentary affair

tools.name: get_committee_meetings
tools.description: Federal parliament committee meeting schedule

tools.name: get_avalanche_bulletin
tools.description: Live SLF avalanche bulletin: danger level (1-5), avalanche problems with aspect and elevation, validity and advice text, for one warning region, a coordinate, or all of Switzerland. Outside the winter season it reports that no bulletin is in force

tools.name: list_avalanche_regions
tools.description: The 135 SLF/EAWS avalanche warning regions (id, name, canton) for get_avalanche_bulletin

tools.name: list_air_quality_stations
tools.description: List NABEL air-quality monitoring stations (BAFU/Empa)

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: NABEL station info: location, environment type, legal limits (LRV) and a link to BAFU live data (no measurements returned)

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description: Locality, canton and coordinates for a postcode (PLZ)

tools.name: search_postcode
tools.description: Postcodes (PLZ) for a city/locality name

tools.name: list_postcodes_in_canton
tools.description: List postcodes (PLZ) in a canton

tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Swiss Post tracking page URL for a tracking number (no live status: there is no public tracking API)

tools.name: get_electricity_tariff
tools.description: ElCom electricity tariff (Rp./kWh) for a municipality, with component breakdown

tools.name: compare_electricity_tariffs
tools.description: Compare electricity tariffs across 2–20 municipalities

tools.name: search_municipality_energy
tools.description: Find municipality BFS numbers for the electricity tariff tools

tools.name: get_population
tools.description: Permanent resident population (BFS STATPOP) for Switzerland, a canton or all cantons

tools.name: search_statistics
tools.description: Search BFS datasets on opendata.swiss

tools.name: get_statistic
tools.description: Details and resource links for a BFS dataset by opendata.swiss ID (from search_statistics)

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List currencies with SNB CHF exchange rates

tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Latest SNB monthly-average CHF exchange rate for a currency

tools.name: get_exchange_rate_history
tools.description: Historical SNB monthly-average CHF exchange rates (default: last 90 months)

tools.name: get_waste_collection
tools.description: Upcoming waste collection dates for a ZIP code. Zurich city only (8001–8099, OpenERZ)

tools.name: list_waste_types
tools.description: List waste collection types. Zurich city only (OpenERZ)

tools.name: get_waste_calendar
tools.description: Monthly waste collection calendar for a ZIP code. Zurich city only (8001–8099, OpenERZ)

tools.name: get_swiss_news
tools.description: Latest SRF news headlines

tools.name: search_swiss_news
tools.description: Keyword search in current SRF headlines (all categories)

tools.name: get_voting_results
tools.description: Popular vote (Volksabstimmung) results as counted in Basel-Stadt: national and cantonal votes since 2021

tools.name: search_votes
tools.description: Search popular votes by title keyword (Basel-Stadt results)

tools.name: get_vote_details
tools.description: Per-district Basel-Stadt results (Basel, Riehen, Bettingen, abroad) for one vote. Give vote_title and/or date

tools.name: search_dams
tools.description: Search federally supervised dams by dam or reservoir name (SFOE)

tools.name: get_dams_by_canton
tools.description: Federally supervised dams in a canton

tools.name: get_dam_details
tools.description: Full technical details of one dam by name

tools.name: get_trail_closures
tools.description: Current hiking trail closures and detours (ASTRA/Schweizer Wanderwege)

tools.name: get_trail_closures_nearby
tools.description: Hiking trail closures and detours near a WGS84 point

tools.name: get_property_price_index
tools.description: BFS residential property price index (IMPI), quarterly since 2017Q1, Q4 2019 = 100

tools.name: search_real_estate_data
tools.description: Search opendata.swiss for real-estate/housing datasets (prices, rents, construction, vacancies)

tools.name: get_rent_index
tools.description: BFS consumer price index (CPI/LIK, incl. rents), monthly, Dec 1982 = 100. Not a dedicated rent index; for purchase prices use get_property_price_index

tools.name: get_traffic_count
tools.description: ASTRA traffic counting station volumes by location name

tools.name: get_traffic_by_canton
tools.description: ASTRA traffic counting stations in a canton (max 20)

tools.name: get_traffic_nearby
tools.description: ASTRA traffic counting stations near a WGS84 point

tools.name: get_recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes in and around Switzerland (SED, ETH Zürich)

tools.name: get_earthquake_details
tools.description: Full details of one seismic event by SED event ID

tools.name: search_earthquakes_by_location
tools.description: Earthquakes within a radius of a WGS84 point (SED)

tools.name: get_snow_conditions
tools.description: Current snow depth and 24h new snow at SLF IMIS stations, deepest first

tools.name: list_snow_stations
tools.description: List SLF snow stations (IMIS automatic, manual study plots)

tools.name: get_snow_measurements
tools.description: Measurements for one SLF station: IMIS 30-min snow/weather data, or study-plot daily snow data

tools.name: get_pollen_current
tools.description: Latest hourly pollen concentrations (alder, birch, hazel, beech, ash, oak, grasses) at a MeteoSwiss station

tools.name: get_pollen_daily
tools.description: Daily average pollen concentrations at a MeteoSwiss station

tools.name: list_pollen_stations
tools.description: List MeteoSwiss pollen stations
